archetypes.name: dyn-outline-contract
archetypes.rationale: Prose compression touched a prompt contract with byte-stable literals.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the compressed Step 1d.7 design-outline reference for behavior drift. Focus on entry guards, approval/refine/cancel control flow, skip-approve handling, and downstream consumer conditions. Verify the preserved literals and schema fence remain suitable for existing harnesses. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
